FECrys documentation¶

FECrys combines molecular simulation, internal-coordinate representations, normalising flows, and statistically rigorous free-energy estimators for molecular crystals.

The documentation is organised around two complementary views:

  • Figure 1 architecture map connects the architecture in Figure 1 of the manuscript to its implementation; and

  • API reference lists every active class and function, including signatures, docstrings, and direct GitHub source links.
